tools.name: list_active_incidents
tools.description: LIVE: cloud and SaaS incidents open right now (AWS, Azure, GCP, Cloudflare, GitHub, Stripe, …), quoted from each provider's own status page with a link, refreshed several times a day. Use for 'is X down', 'why is X failing', or anything after your training cutoff. Filter by provider, region or compo

tools.name: provider_reliability
tools.description: LIVE: reliability index, incident count and median recovery time per cloud/SaaS provider over the current window, from their official status pages. Use for 'how reliable is X' or 'which provider is more stable'. Deterministic: no model in the loop. Prefer it over `answer`.

tools.name: exploited_vulnerabilities
tools.description: LIVE: CVEs being exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), ranked patch-first by CVSS × EPSS exploitation probability × known ransomware use, with CISA due date, patch availability and the factors behind each rank. Use for 'what should we patch first', 'is CVE-X exploited', or recent vulnerabilities your tr

tools.name: threat_advisories
tools.description: LIVE: CISA's newest security advisories (CSAF: industrial control systems, medical devices, general vulnerabilities), each with its ID, affected vendors, CVEs, CVSS, the opening of CISA's mitigation text and the CISA link. Use for 'what did CISA advise this week' or 'any CISA advisory for <vendor>'.

tools.name: security_headlines
tools.description: LIVE: headlines from eight security trade outlets (BleepingComputer, The Hacker News, SecurityWeek, The Record, Krebs on Security, …): headline, outlet, date and link only, never the article text. Use for 'any breach news about X', 'what attacks are in the news this week'; read the article at its li

tools.name: deploy_check
tools.description: LIVE, from the 5-minute status poll: proceed true, false, or "unknown" for deploying to one provider (optionally one region), with the open incidents behind it and data_age_minutes. Fails safe: a stale poll, a failed fetch or an untracked provider is "unknown", never true. Planned maintenance alone

tools.name: network_conditions
tools.description: MEASURED evidence, not only what providers say. For a provider: its official status plus outage.me's own response-time check of its domain against its recent median. For an ISP (e.g. 'Virgin Media', 'Comcast'): its status page when it has one, outage-grade problems from users' consented speed sample

tools.name: check_site
